messages:
Noah (People Ops): Heads-up: final reviewer rotation and handback exceptions doc posted. Please confirm your team's handback preference (manager-first or auto-send) by Thursday EOD. Sheet: https://docs.internal/reviews/rotation

Rina (People Ops): Reminder checklist: 1) reviewers block 2h/day for at least 6 business days; 2) nominate overflow backup; 3) mark interview conflicts. Form edits close May 5 23:59 UTC.

Omar (Eng Mgr): Can we limit late-night APAC reviewer slots to two per person? I'll nominate two backups on my team.

Sofia (SWE): I can do one late APAC slot, prefer not to have calibration right after on-call handover.

Ben (Recruiter): I'll export interviews and mark conflicts in the sheet by tomorrow morning. Please set recruiter events to busy so conflict script catches them.

handback-bot: Reminder: forms-lock scheduled May 5 23:59 UTC. Conflict-check job set for Friday 09:00 UTC.

Noah (People Ops): LOA & reopen FAQ: if an employee misses the window due to verified LOA, file the exception form; people-ops triages within 48h. Approved reopens get a 72h reviewer turnaround and are marked REOPENED in the audit log.

Rina (People Ops): If a reviewer cancels <24h, we auto-assign from overflow pool and send invite. Overflow members agreed to max 2 reassigns. Managers: nominate overflow by Wed noon.

Omar (Eng Mgr): Thanks 50 I'll add my nominations and set my team's handback to manager-first.

Sofia (SWE): Done 50 added my conflicts and noted my preferred deep-work windows.

Noah (People Ops): Final: teams must confirm handback policy + reviewer nominations by Thu EOD. Questions? Ping @people-ops or drop into office hours Wed 16:00 UTC.
